summary: Dragonfly Energy Holdings Corp. filed a Form 8-K on April 23, 2026, announcing it received an allowance from the Japan Patent Office for a patent application related to powderized solid-state electrolyte and electroactive materials. This patent is part of its solid-state battery and dry electrode manufacturing technology. No financial terms, board recommendations, or advisers are mentioned. The filing is a routine intellectual property update, not a special situation event. There is no transaction, activist involvement, or strategic review triggered by this news.
